title: R3 v1 API surface approval inventory

classification_policy.IMPLEMENT: Keep the designed method/path or audit an additional W5/runtime-only operation.
classification_policy.EQUIVALENT: Use existing runtime operations only where the same domain effect and evidence can be proved.
classification_policy.DEFER: Do not add the designed operation in R3 without explicit user approval.
classification_policy.runtime_rolling: An IMPLEMENT/PLANNED entry has null runtime mapping only while its exact route is absent. As soon as the route lands, set exact runtime_method/runtime_path, keep operationId equal to the entry operation_id, refresh runtime_contracts and the Markdown hash/summary, but keep implementation_state=PLANNED until Task 16 closure.

approval_required.decision: Approved: 6 EQUIVALENT + 1 redundant launch alias DEFER + 8 full-scope IMPLEMENT + pin-max-4 session-local.
local_state_decisions: candidate comparison pins are session-local UI state capped at four; they are not candidate-selection or holdout state
equivalent_semantic_deltas: APPROVAL REQUIRED: review detail changes opaque review_id identity to a one-to-many spec_hash lookup that selects the latest packet-bearing experiment; a later rerun can change the experiment_id returned by a refreshed queue, so clients must treat experiment_id as a navigation resolution and bundle_hash as the final immutable audit identity, rejecting stale bundle_hash submissions

candidate_evidence_bundle_proposal.decision: Approved Task 9 artifact contract: ArtifactManifest v1 and Research SQLite Schema v1 remain unchanged with no DDL; add fold_selection_trace_exposures_v1 and candidate_evidence_bundle_v1; ReviewPacket v3 is write-current while v1/v2 remain read-only without migration/backfill; ETF uses NOT_APPLICABLE/ETF_LANE.
candidate_evidence_bundle_proposal.schema_change_policy: Approved without ArtifactManifest or Research SQLite schema change: both remain v1 and the existing generic content-addressed artifact envelope/index is reused. No DDL, migration, backfill, architecture allowance, or additional environment configuration is authorized.
candidate_evidence_bundle_proposal.fold_source_rule: Every fold source is selected by the current comparison lineage and explicitly binds its terminal successful committed attempt_id and run_id. The builder must never latest/max guess; failed attempts and old retry attempts are excluded.
candidate_evidence_bundle_proposal.bundle_identity: candidate_bundle_artifact_id and content_hash are the one immutable artifact identity exposed by all three drill-down pages; page artifact_id/content_hash never identify a single fold artifact.
candidate_evidence_bundle_proposal.first_page_resolution: A request without cursor resolves only the candidate bundle referenced by the current comparison_payload_hash/comparison_revision.
candidate_evidence_bundle_proposal.retry_semantics: A successful retry creates a new comparison revision and a new immutable bundle; the old bundle and its source attempt references remain retained and readable for audit.
candidate_evidence_bundle_proposal.cursor_identity: next_cursor binds candidate bundle content_hash plus resource_kind plus offset. Cross-kind cursor reuse returns INVALID_CANDIDATE_EVIDENCE_CURSOR. If current comparison now references another bundle, a cursor bound to the old hash returns EVIDENCE_STALE.
required_tests: 2+ folds with explicit comparison-selected terminal attempts
retry old/new attempts exclude failed and old retry sources
stable order for every resource kind
restart parity preserves bundle bytes, hash, order, and cursors

operations.reason: Exact cross-strategy review queue projection.

contracts.request_identity: No body; current local review queue.
contracts.revision_etag: Immutable version/spec hash; no ETag.

operations.reason: This is an approval-required resource-identity change: one spec_hash may map one-to-many to rerun experiments, and the queue resolver selects the latest packet-bearing experiment at query time. A refreshed queue can therefore navigate to a different experiment after a rerun; experiment_id is a latest-selection navigation result, while bundle_hash is the final immutable audit identity and stale bundle submissions must fail closed.

contracts.request_identity: Queue lookup is one-to-many by spec_hash and selects the latest packet-bearing experiment_id; clients must carry that resolved experiment_id and the displayed bundle_hash, and must not treat the mapping as stable across queue refreshes.
contracts.response_dto: APIResponse[ExperimentReviewPacketResponse] whose experiment_id identifies the selected rerun and bundle_hash identifies the immutable packet.
contracts.error_codes: 404 packet; 422 path validation; mutation consumers must return EVIDENCE_STALE when the submitted bundle_hash no longer matches the intended review packet.
contracts.idempotency: Read-only lookup is not idempotency-keyed; latest selection can change after a rerun even though each returned packet is immutable.
contracts.revision_etag: bundle_hash, not spec_hash or queue position, is the final immutable audit identity; stale bundle_hash must be rejected by submit/publish.

user_approval.decision: Approved the recorded replacement of review_id detail with the latest packet-bearing experiment review-packet, with bundle_hash as immutable audit identity.

proof.request_identity: This is not one-to-one: spec_hash has a one-to-many relationship with rerun experiments, and the queue resolver selects the latest packet-bearing experiment at each query.
proof.response_dto: The selected packet contains hard gates, evidence hashes, rationale, selection refs, R1 impact hash, experiment_id, and immutable bundle_hash.
proof.error_codes: Missing selected packet is 404; later submit/publish must reject a stale bundle_hash as EVIDENCE_STALE.
proof.idempotency: The read has no mutation replay, and a repeated read after a rerun may resolve a newer experiment; each returned bundle remains immutable.
proof.revision_etag: bundle_hash is the final audit identity and stale guard; spec_hash alone cannot fence rerun selection.
proof.maturity: Both are experimental research review surfaces.
proof.audit_evidence: The latest-selection delta requires user approval; audit trails bind the chosen experiment_id and bundle_hash, never only spec_hash.
